subject: sociology

moments.title: The Constitution of Society
moments.body: Giddens's structuration theory argues structure and agency are mutually constituted, with the 'duality of structure'.
moments.takeaway: Structuration theory aimed to dissolve the structure-agency dichotomy.

moments.title: The Consequences of Modernity
moments.body: Giddens characterises late modernity through time-space distanciation, disembedding and reflexivity.
moments.takeaway: Modernity is a distinctive social form, not just continuity from tradition.

moments.title: The Third Way
moments.body: Giddens's policy book influences Blair's New Labour and centre-left politics across Europe.
moments.takeaway: Social theory can directly shape political practice.

now.title: Modernity and risk
now.body: Giddens's frameworks coexist with Beck's risk society and Bauman's liquid modernity in contemporary theory.
now.open_questions: Does climate change require a different theory of modernity?

reflection: Giddens combined high theory with public-intellectual reach more than any UK sociologist of his generation.
